morphling_ebb_and_flow.name: Ebb and Flow
morphling_ebb_and_flow.description: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
morphling_ebb_and_flow.note0: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

morphling_waveform.name: Waveform
morphling_waveform.description: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
morphling_waveform.lore: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.
morphling_waveform.facet_morphling_agi: Waveform attacks enemies in his path. Does not apply on-hit effects.
morphling_waveform.reverse_custom_description: This ability can be cast within %delay% seconds of Waveform to return to its original position.

morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.name: Adaptive Strike
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.description: Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.\n\nKnockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.facet_morphling_str: Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength.
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.lore: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.

morphling_morph_agi.name: Attribute Shift (Agility Gain)
morphling_morph_agi.description: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
morphling_morph_agi.shard_description: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
morphling_morph_agi.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
morphling_morph_agi.note0: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
morphling_morph_agi.note1: Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.

morphling_morph_str.name: Attribute Shift (Strength Gain)
morphling_morph_str.description: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
morphling_morph_str.shard_description: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
morphling_morph_str.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
morphling_morph_str.note0: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
morphling_morph_str.note1: Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.

morphling_replicate.name: Morph
morphling_replicate.description: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
morphling_replicate.scepter_description: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.
morphling_replicate.lore: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.
morphling_replicate.note0: You can't target yourself with Morph.
morphling_replicate.note1: Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
